results.title: PayGlocal to raise Rs 36.4 crore from Beenext at Rs 1,140 crore valuation
results.description: The company’s shareholders on July 25 approved the issue of 5,074 pre-series C compulsorily convertible preference shares at Rs 71,693.02 apiece to the fund through a private placement. The transaction marks a 32% increase from the Rs 865 crore valuation in its previous round.
